title: Domi's More Useful Tools
description: A bunch of tools and weapons..
body:
Domi´s More Useful Tools(DMUT) Adds:

Weapons(Special):

**Freeze Tool** - Freezes Enemy For 3 seconds
**Poison Tool** - Poisons Enemy For 3 seconds
**Despawn Tool**(OP) - Despawns Enemy
**Lightning** - Summons Lightning At Enemy. But Has One Duralibity
**CurtClears Gravity Changer** - Slow Downs Enemy.

Weapons(Reacreation Of Normal Weapons):


**Super Tools**(OP) - Combination of each Tools using all tiers. For Example: Super Sword: wooden Sword + Stone Sword + Iron Sword + Gold Sword + Diamond Sword + Netherite Sword

**Copper Tools**: Just Copper Tools. Faster then iron but less duralibity and cant mine diamond.

Electrized Copper Sword(OP)- Strikes A Lighting At Enemy and gives you Resistance 255 for very small time so you dont get damage.

Other Stuff:

Poisonous Flint - Used To Craft Poison Tool
Bottle Of Lightning - Used To craft Lightning.
Electricity Block - Used To craft Electrized Copper Sword but also when you step on you it will shoot at you Lightning Strikes.
Ice Staff.

Curseforge Link(Older Versions Exclusive): https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/domis-more-useful-tools
